messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for rotation 'oncall-primary' — incident id PD-99123. Trigger: node-exporter: hostdown -> gpu-node-7a (us-west-2). Auto-page to eng-oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty | Alert: hostdown: gpu-node-7a | Severity: P1 | Triggered at 2026-03-15T10:12:01Z.

sam-ops: ack'd. I'm looking.

maria-oncall: i'm up — grabbing logs. any customer reports?

david-sre: seeing elevated 503s from model-proxy-usw1-*. Rolling alert from LB. Not many customers but a few high-traffic tenants.

jess-frontend: reporting SLO warnings from realtime inference for tenant acme-inc — spike in tail latency ~2x.

sam-ops: node shows kernel panic last heartbeat. kubelet not ready. Host unreachable via ssh.

maria-oncall: can you paste the dmesg/snippet if available?

sam-ops: here's the last syslog chunk from node-exporter scrape we have (best-effort):
```
Mar 15 10:11:58 gpu-node-7a kernel: NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: GPU reset failed (error 77)!
Mar 15 10:11:59 gpu-node-7a kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: watchdog: GPU hang detected
Mar 15 10:12:00 gpu-node-7a systemd: Kernel panic - dumping stack
```

maria-oncall: that looks like a hard GPU hang -> kernel panic. likely hardware or driver.

david-sre: kubectl from control plane shows node NotReady and kubelet last seen 3m ago. pods on node: model-serving-prod-12, model-serving-prod-14, sidecar-logs.

sam-ops: i'm going to cordon + failover traffic for model-service shards on that node. will attempt drain to move pods.

eng-release: tagging in for customer comms — which tenants impacted and temporary mitigation?

jess-frontend: acme-inc and two small internal test projects currently had pods on that node. their requests either 503 or high latency.

maria-oncall: commands i'll run from control-plane:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7a
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-7a
kubectl drain gpu-node-7a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30
```

sam-ops: running cordon now.

incident-bot: Action: node cordoned by maria-oncall at 2026-03-15T10:15:04Z.

maria-oncall: drain started — eviction attempts failing for model-serving-prod-12 (CrashLoopBackOff) so kube-scheduler not placing replacement fast enough due to cluster GPU reservation. Trying manual scale up of spare capacity.

david-sre: scaling up dedicated-pool-usw1 by +1 GPU node (t3-gpu-48) to accept evicted pods.

eng-release: proceed with failover routing for acme-inc? we can route to us-east-1 fallback pool for latency-sensitive flows.

sam-ops: agree. I'll flip the routing for the affected model-route in the routing table (canary fallback) to fallback-us-east-1.

jess-frontend: please post the exact route id, will notify ACME contacts.

sam-ops: route id: model-embed-v2-usw1. issuing change:
```json
{"route":"model-embed-v2-usw1","action":"set-fallback","target":"fallback-use1","reason":"gpu-node-7a outage"}
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-99123 acknowledged and assigned to sam-ops / maria-oncall / david-sre.

maria-oncall: scale up finished, drain resumed. most pods successfully evicted and rescheduled to new node. one pod failed due to image pull timeout — restarted.

david-sre: monitoring metrics — 503s dropping back to baseline, latency improving but tail still 1.3x for acme until routing completes.

eng-release: notifying acme-inc: "We're investigating an infrastructure incident affecting a small subset of inference traffic in us-west-2. We've routed affected traffic to a fallback region and are working on restoring the node. We'll update within 30 minutes." cc @acme-support.

jess-frontend: ACME replied: thanks for quick action, please keep us posted.

sam-ops: trying controlled reboot of gpu-node-7a via BMC. ping timed out earlier; scheduling remote powercycle now.

incident-bot: Action: powercycle requested at 2026-03-15T10:24:11Z by sam-ops. IPMI job 7723 queued.

maria-oncall: monitoring serial log while RMM powercycles. attaching last serial snippet: 
```
U-Boot > Booting kernel...
[    3.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65): 79, pid 0b, GPU lockup - resetting
[   12.234567] kernel: System halted for inspection
```

sam-ops: node came back online per IPMI, ssh still flaky but kubelet rejoined as Ready.

incident-bot: Node gpu-node-7a status changed to Ready at 2026-03-15T10:32:09Z.

david-sre: pods on node are up, model-serving-prod* at 99.9% success now. rolling health checks passing.

maria-oncall: doing post-recovery checks: nvml logs show repeated GPU ECC errors prior to panic. Opening RMA ticket with vendor (RMA-5599).

sam-ops: temporary mitigation: cordon again (we don't want this node in rotation until vendor confirms) and mark as maintenance.

```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7a
kubectl label node gpu-node-7a maintenance=hardware_rma
```

eng-release: update to customers: incident mitigated; traffic was routed to fallback for ~17 minutes; minor request errors for some tenants. Follow-up: we will schedule a maintenance window and follow-up postmortem.

jess-frontend: ACME replies: appreciate the swift failover. no SLA hit reported on their side.

sam-ops: summary for postmortem: root cause likely GPU ECC + firmware/driver-induced reset failure leading to kernel panic. Immediate fix: powercycle + route failover. Next steps: RMA, firmware update on replacement, review capacity cushions for us-west-2.

incident-bot: PD-99123 resolved by sam-ops at 2026-03-15T10:35:21Z.

maria-oncall: adding notes to incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-99123 — will run ev-logs and attach nvml dump.

david-sre: tagging follow-up owner: sam-ops (hardware) & eng-runtime (driver testing) — ping @eng-release for customer comms.

eng-release: acknowledged. drafting postmortem, will sync tomorrow.

sam-ops: thanks everyone. I'll hand off to ops for RMA and close this channel. :white_check_mark:
